name: Torch
description: A wooden stick wrapped with oil-soaked cloth that provides light when lit.
notes: Light it with a tinderbox: it goes into your off hand and burns for 1 hour.
Hold it lit in your off hand: night fights outdoors without the darkness penalty (no need with darkvision).
At night in the wild a lit light gives you away: whatever might ambush you sees you coming (−5 Stealth).
Once it goes out (burnt down or put out), it's spent.
